I use data to tell stories and solve problems -- by building pipelines that turn messy data into decisions people can act on.
Right now I am finishing my M.S. in Data Science at **Willamette University**,
where my capstone maps grant and scholarship funding against Oregon needs (capstone.qmd) for
The Ford Family Foundation.

I care about equity, access to resources, education, healthcare, fitness, economics, reproducible workflows, and explaining a model to the person who has to trust it.

**Currently looking for** data analyst / data scientist / data engineer / ML engineer roles
starting September 2026. [Get in touch](about.qmd) or grab my
[resume](resume.qmd).
